pages.title: Koron Domino
pages.creator: Smidem
pages.description:
Koron Domino is a logic puzzle about arranging one continuous domino chain. Rotate the tiles until the route connects to every bell, then press Push to set the pieces falling. Some layouts require branches, so the chain must divide correctly to ring several bells in a single attempt.

The game includes 150 handmade levels and a daily puzzle, with no timer limiting your planning. Stars unlock different domino appearances, including sakura, matcha, and ramune themes. Inspect every branch before starting the chain and check that none of the bells has been left disconnected.

pages.title: Bongo Bounce
pages.creator: Genecogni Games
pages.description: Keep a slime bouncing with your drum in Bongo Bounce. Each bounce adds to the rhythm, and hitting the bumpers in time builds the soundtrack as you play. Land precise hits to trigger Fever and collect notes during a run. Unlock different slimes and drum kits as you work toward a higher score.

pages.title: Harvest Glam
pages.creator: Gamerina
pages.description: Put together a fall makeover in Harvest Glam. Start with warm makeup tones and gold highlights, then choose a hairstyle and outfit that bring out the palette. Use earthy colors and rustic accessories for an autumn look, or lean into the gold for a more dressed-up style.

pages.title: Web Shot: Spider Superhero
pages.creator: Prime Web Publish
pages.description: Swing between skyscrapers on a web in Web Shot: Spider Superhero. Explore the 3D city and get down to street level to fight gangs. Use the hero's powers alongside close-range attacks, then take on the crime bosses behind the trouble. The open city gives you room to move between fights.

pages.title: Quiz X
pages.creator: Freak X Games
pages.description: Pick Casual or Timer mode in Quiz X and answer trivia questions drawn from science and everyday subjects. Read each prompt and choose the answer you think fits. Use Timer mode when you want to put your recall under pressure, or choose Casual for a more leisurely round.

pages.title: Liquid Sort Deluxe
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Pour colored liquids between tubes in Liquid Sort Deluxe until each filled tube contains a single color. Check where you can put the top layer before you pour, and keep an empty space available when you need to move a color out of the way. An optional extra tube gives you more room on a tricky board.

pages.title: Thread Match 2
pages.creator: GameBerry Studio
pages.description: Fill the target spools in Thread Match 2 with thread from the smaller spools below. You can only pick up a spool when the layers above it leave it accessible. Send three spools of the same color to a target to complete it, then work out which moves will open up the colors you still need.

pages.title: VR World
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Pick up and move miniature people in VR World as if they were puppets. Drag them around the scene or fight them, then try a different role such as a police officer or an ambulance driver. The game uses the idea of VR-style object manipulation in a browser.

pages.title: Hide Me
pages.creator: Eyestorm Pte. LTD.
pages.description: Duck into objects in Hide Me to stay out of sight while enemies search for you. Tap to hide and see how long you can avoid detection. As you unlock new areas, look for places to disappear and use power-ups to help you survive the chase.

pages.title: Mahjong Cute Tiles
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Turn the board to inspect a 3D Mahjong layout in Mahjong Cute Tiles. Find matching tiles you can remove and rotate the arrangement to check sides that were hidden from view. If you get stuck, use a hint, shuffle the tiles, undo a move, or try a bomb to open up the board.

pages.title: Black Pink Halloween Concert
pages.creator: Cutedressup
pages.description: Style the K-pop group for a Halloween performance in Black Pink Halloween Concert. Pick costumes for the members, then try hairstyles and accessories that suit the stage theme. Give each performer a different look or use shared colors and details to bring the group together.

pages.title: Magic Tiles 3
pages.creator: Amanotes
pages.description: Tap black piano tiles as they arrive in Magic Tiles 3 and keep your timing with the song. Leave the white tiles alone as the notes come down the screen. Choose a track across styles such as pop, EDM, or hip-hop and see how far you can follow its rhythm.

pages.title: Unstack Tower
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: Take apart a tower of colorful cubes in Unstack Tower. Tap to remove or drop blocks and look for groups of three or more of the same color. Wood and glass pieces change the layout you have to work with. Check what a cube is supporting before moving it, since an unbalanced tower can collapse.

pages.title: Bombardino Crocodilo terror jumpscare
pages.creator: Breymantech
pages.description: Search an abandoned mansion in Bombardino Crocodilo terror jumpscare. You are trapped inside, and getting out means finding the dolls hidden along the dark corridors. Keep track of where you have searched as you make your way from room to room and try to escape with the whole collection.

pages.title: Last Standing
pages.creator: yiyuan
pages.description: Start unarmed in Last Standing and search the map for weapons and equipment before the other survivors close in. Choose when to keep looking for supplies and when to fight with what you have found. The objective is to outlast everyone else dropped into the match.

pages.title: Qube 2048
pages.creator: Mirra Games
pages.description: Qube 2048 turns number doubling into a route across a grid of blocks. Start at two and move from block to block to build a higher value. Look ahead for obstacles before choosing where to move, since the route you take affects how far you can keep doubling.

pages.title: THE SURVEY
pages.creator: NISHAD_Games
pages.description: Sit down at a computer and answer an unsettling questionnaire in THE SURVEY. Read the prompts as an ordinary evening turns into a short horror story. The survey begins to show things you did not expect to see, and the game unfolds as you keep interacting with it.

pages.title: Untwist Road
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Collect cylinders in Untwist Road and use them to unroll a path ahead of you. Watch what is coming so you have enough road to get across the next obstacle. Unlock new levels and try another run when you want to improve your record.

pages.title: Tap Away
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Clear the blue blocks in Tap Away by launching them in the directions marked on their faces. Rotate the structure to see which arrows have a clear path out. A piece that is blocked from one angle may become available after you send a neighboring piece away.

pages.title: Stack Sorting
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Stack Sorting asks you to group colored cylinders before the clock runs out. Move a top piece to an empty stack or onto a cylinder of the same color. Easy mode gives you more room to rearrange pieces, while Hard mode leaves fewer stacks available for temporary moves.

pages.title: Dollys Restaurant Organizing
pages.creator: Yiv.Com
pages.description: Put a cluttered restaurant in order in Dollys Restaurant Organizing. Work out which objects belong together, where they should be stored, and what to clean first. The challenge feels like a placement puzzle because the right item needs to go in the right spot before the whole setup comes together.

pages.title: Last War Survival
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Fight through lanes of enemies in Last War Survival. Dodge what you can and shoot through waves of soldiers in your path. Collect coins and improve your gear between fights so you are better prepared when a giant boss blocks the route.

pages.title: Pet Salon 2
pages.creator: BPTop
pages.description: Look after a puppy and a cat in Pet Salon 2. Bathe the pets, help them when they are sick, and choose an outfit when they are ready to dress up. Move between care and styling as you work through the salon activities for each animal.

pages.title: Planet Takeover
pages.creator: Friendzy
pages.description: Connect planets you control to enemy worlds in Planet Takeover. Build up a foothold and use it to push farther across the galaxy. Decide which world to link to next and look for a route that gives you more ways to reach the remaining planets.

pages.title: Yes or No Challenge Run
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Run across platforms and pick answers at the gates in Yes or No Challenge Run. The questions and rewards change up the run, and pets or machines can help along the way. Play alone or with a second player and see where your answers take you.

pages.title: Cooking Festival
pages.creator: Boombit S.A.
pages.description: Cook for customers in Cooking Festival as you work through kitchens around the world. Make dishes such as pancakes, grilled ribs, and Italian pizza, and serve ice cream along the way. Keep track of what needs cooking and what is ready to serve as different kitchens change the menu.

pages.title: LowPoly 3D Art
pages.creator: AA2G1
pages.description: Rotate a model and color its triangular faces by number in LowPoly 3D Art. Turn the object to reach facets on the far side and use the number guide to choose the right color. Work through models such as animals, fruit, toys, and geometric shapes.

pages.title: Tile Match Farm
pages.creator: Synk Inc.
pages.description: Take animal tiles from the top of the board in Tile Match Farm. Three of the same animal clear from your tray, while covered tiles stay out of reach until you remove what is above them. The tray holds seven tiles, so check whether you can finish a set before filling the last space.

pages.title: Color Page ASMR
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Pick up a brush in Color Page ASMR and follow the example to color each drawing. Match the paint to the area shown in the guide, then move on to the next part of the picture. Work through the colors one section at a time until the page is complete.

pages.title: Heart of Iona
pages.creator: 2Play
pages.description: Make choices for Ella in Heart of Iona, a story set in motion by an attack on the day of her coronation. Ella finds an imprisoned dragon in a hidden chamber and helps it escape. Decide what she does as the adventure unfolds and her choices begin to shape the kingdom's fate.

pages.title: Snake Island 3D
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Collect fruit to grow your snake in Snake Island 3D. Compete against the other snakes on the island in Survival or switch to Racing for a different objective. Gain levels to unlock more skins as you learn when to look for fruit and when to get away from a rival.

pages.title: Ball Sort Halloween
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description: Sort the Halloween monster balls into separate tubes in Ball Sort Halloween. Move the balls between tubes until each group is made up of a single color. Plan where you can temporarily store a ball when it is in the way of the color you need underneath.

pages.title: Muscles Rush
pages.creator: 2Play
pages.description: Pick up dumbbells that match your color in Muscles Rush. The weights build up your character so you can break through obstacles on the course. Choose a route that gives you the strength you need while keeping you ahead of the other racers on the way to the finish.

pages.title: Red vs Dead
pages.creator: Amr Osama
pages.description: Clear the cemetery before its zombies reach the city in Red vs Dead. Control the red-haired fighter and use an antique gun against the undead. Stay alive while dealing with the zombies in front of you, then look for the next opening as you work through the cemetery.

pages.title: Lazy Jumper
pages.creator: Seryas Games
pages.description: Send the lazy jumper bouncing toward the pool in Lazy Jumper. Break through objects in the way to pick up stars, and keep the jump moving until he lands in the water. The route to the pool is also a chance to see what you can smash along the way.

pages.title: Grass Cutter
pages.creator: 2Play
pages.description: Swipe to move a spinning blade through the grass in Grass Cutter. Work through layouts decorated with flowers and check which strips you still need to cut after each move. Look at the shape of the next patch before you swipe so the blade heads where you need it.

pages.title: Frog Fights With Buddies
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Hop between lily pads in Frog Fights With Buddies. Eat bugs to score and kick other frogs into the water when they get close enough. The first frog to reach 15 points wins, so keep track of nearby rivals as you decide which pad to jump to next.

pages.title: Color Fill
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description: Move colored blocks across the gray and black board in Color Fill. Fill the cells and collect every diamond as you go. Look at where the unfilled spaces are before moving a block so you can work out how to reach the parts of the board you still need.

pages.title: Puppy Jump
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Guide a puppy upward in Puppy Jump by hopping from tile to tile. Aim for solid tiles and keep clear of dangerous ones or tiles that can break beneath the puppy. Check the next landing before each jump and see how high you can climb.

pages.title: Europe Soccer Cup 2021
pages.creator: YO-YOgames
pages.description: Choose from 24 national teams in Europe Soccer Cup 2021. Aim a player and set the power to send them toward the ball, then take turns with the opposition. Use each move to line up a shot or put a player between the ball and your own goal as you compete for the cup.

pages.title: Fish Rescue Pull the Pin
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Get water to the stranded fish in Fish Rescue Pull the Pin. Look at how the chambers are divided and choose which pin to remove so the water can flow through. Check where the opening leads before pulling, since the layout decides what reaches the fish.

pages.title: Lab Escape Online
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Help an escaped experiment survive in Lab Escape Online. Guide the creature through the lab and devour the living things it can reach to make it grow. Improve its equipment and collect hats as you progress, then use what you have earned to help the creature get farther.

pages.title: Dr Panda Airport
pages.creator: Dr. Panda LTD
pages.description: Take on airport jobs in Dr Panda Airport. Stamp passports, sort luggage so it reaches the correct plane, and help guide aircraft in for a safe landing. Ten mini-games cover different parts of the trip, from checking documents to handling what happens on the runway.

pages.title: Deadswitch 3
pages.creator: Wilkin Games
pages.description: Deadswitch 3 lets you fight online or set up your own matches against bots. Choose a map and mode, then build a class around the weapons and killstreaks you want to use. Customize your character and unlock equipment as you progress through the ranks.

pages.title: Monster Truck 2D
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Drive a monster truck across side-view tracks in Monster Truck 2D. Collect coins and attempt stunts as you head for the finish. Watch the truck's angle when the terrain changes so a jump leaves you in a position to keep driving after you land.

pages.title: U.S. Army Hidden
pages.creator: STA network
pages.description: Find ten stars hidden in each picture in U.S. Army Hidden. There are six scenes to search, each with a countdown. Look closely before clicking, because repeated misses take five more seconds off the timer. A careful scan can save time when only a few stars remain.

pages.title: Protect the Earth
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Defend the planet from orbit in Protect the Earth. Shoot incoming meteorites and asteroids before they get through to Earth. Watch for bonuses during the attack, since they can improve your protection or give you stronger weapons for the next objects heading toward the planet.

pages.title: Clash of Skulls
pages.creator: BeedoGames
pages.description: Deploy skeleton units in Clash of Skulls and try to destroy the opposing base. The battle runs in real time, so choose when to send a unit as well as which one to send. Mix different troops to build an attack that can push through the enemy's defenses.

pages.title: Cargo Euro Truck Drive Car Transport New
pages.creator: jungleGamesStudio
pages.description: Haul racing cars from the factory to the showroom in Cargo Euro Truck Drive Car Transport New. Drive a truck with a car-carrying trailer attached and account for the length of the load as you steer. The job is to deliver the vehicles to the garage showroom.

pages.title: Police Car Simulator 3d
pages.creator: Driving games
pages.description: Take a police car onto city streets in Police Car Simulator 3d. Choose from different vehicles and drive around the 3D environment. Watch the road as you steer through the city and get a feel for how each car handles.

pages.title: offroad bus
pages.creator: gameworld
pages.description: Drive a bus across hilly terrain in offroad bus. Stop to pick up passengers, then take them to their destinations along the off-road route. Keep the bus under control around bends and on steep stretches while you work through the stops.

pages.title: Baby Hazel Hair Care
pages.creator: Baby Hazel
pages.description: Help with a haircut and scalp treatment in Baby Hazel Hair Care. Trim Hazel's long hair, treat the dandruff, and help her wash. Offer her toys when she needs a distraction so she stays happy as you work through each part of the routine.

pages.title: Autumn Queen Beauty Contest
pages.creator: Games Banner Network
pages.description: Style the contestants in Autumn Queen Beauty Contest around the colors of fall. Try bronze, orange, red, or yellow in the outfits, then add accessories made with dried leaves and flowers. Compare the finished looks and see which princess takes the autumn crown.

pages.title: Cartoon Ambulance Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Assemble six cartoon ambulance scenes in Cartoon Ambulance Puzzle. Pick an image and choose a board with 16, 36, 64, or 100 pieces. Look for familiar parts of the vehicle and details in the background to place pieces, especially on the boards with more pieces.

pages.title: Cartoon Bike Jigsaw
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Choose from twelve bike pictures in Cartoon Bike Jigsaw. Put one together on low, medium, or high difficulty. The game gives you as much time as you need, so you can work on the outside edges or build up a recognizable part of the bike first.

pages.title: Master Sudoku
pages.creator: DAB3Games
pages.description: Master Sudoku gives you number grids on three difficulty settings. Fill the blank cells so each row, column, and box contains the digits one through nine without repeats. Use the numbers already on the board to narrow your choices and aim to improve your finishing time.

pages.title: Funny Doggy Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Funny Doggy Puzzle turns six illustrations of an anime girl and her dog into jigsaws. Choose a picture and solve it with 16, 36, 64, or 100 pieces. Look for details on the characters to anchor a section when several loose pieces have similar colors.

pages.title: Tower defense : Fish attack
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Defend dry land from an army of sea creatures in Tower defense : Fish attack. Set up defenses to stop fish, jellyfish, turtles, and whales as they advance. Think about where the attackers will pass and position your defenses where they can cover the route.

pages.title: Super Steve World
pages.creator: PowerSlash Studios
pages.description: Jump through retro platforming stages in Super Steve World. Avoid obstacles, fight monsters, and grab power-ups that make enemies easier to defeat. Collect coins along the way and look for hidden lives and stars in places you could miss by heading straight through the level.

pages.title: Sea Treasure Match 3
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Line up matching shells, sea stars, and other ocean pieces in Sea Treasure Match 3. A row or column of three or more clears those pieces. Watch the countdown and choose matches that help meet the level's target before you run out of time.

pages.title: Dot Color Switch
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description: Tap to switch colors in Dot Color Switch and match the dot before it reaches the matching area. Watch the colors as the dots come in so you can tell when to switch. Keep the sequence going to improve your score.

pages.title: Multiplayer Tanks
pages.creator: Paradine
pages.description: Enter an online tank deathmatch in Multiplayer Tanks. Move your tank, aim, and fire at other players using the mouse and keyboard. Watch where rivals are coming from so you can steer out of their line of fire and set up your own shots.

pages.title: Rob Runner
pages.creator: Bnagames
pages.description: Help Rob pick up diamonds in Rob Runner. Run through the space-themed course and jump over obstacles that interrupt the route. Time each leap so you can get past the hazard and stay on course for the next diamond as you build your score.

pages.title: Miracle Hidden Car
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Search each scene for hidden cars in Miracle Hidden Car. Look over the whole picture and click the cars you spot, including ones that blend into their surroundings. Move on to the next image when you have found the cars in the current level.

pages.title: Mermaid Games
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Choose between styling a mermaid and putting pictures together in Mermaid Games. In dress-up, try different tails, hairstyles, tiaras, and jewelry on the character. Switch to the puzzle mode when you want to fit the pieces of a mermaid-themed scene into place.

pages.title: Pop Those Squares
pages.creator: Physical Form
pages.description: In Pop Those Squares, tap an empty field where matching squares can be seen in straight lines from that spot. Choose a space that lets you pop the squares as new ones appear on the board. Reach 130 points to move on to the next level.

pages.title: EG Stack Jump
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description: Jump as blocks slide toward you in EG Stack Jump. Time the leap so you land on the incoming block and make the tower taller. Work through six levels of increasing difficulty or play endless mode to see how high you can stack before missing a jump.

pages.title: Pool 8 Ball
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description: Play eight-ball alone against the clock or share one device with a second player in Pool 8 Ball. Aim the cue and line up a shot that leaves the white ball in a useful position. In two-player play, clear your group before taking on the eight ball.

pages.title: Storm City Mafia
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Fight through 30 stages in Storm City Mafia. Move and jump through each area, swap weapons when you need a different attack, and throw grenades at enemies. Watch for power-ups and use the slow-time ability when you need longer to react.

pages.title: Soccer Cars
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Play football with cars in Soccer Cars. Knock a loose wheel toward your opponent's goal and try to score five times before they do. Grab bonuses on the field and try approaching the wheel from the side to get a better angle on goal. You can challenge a friend.

pages.title: Connect Dots
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Connect the points in Connect Dots to solve each layout. Look at where the dots sit before deciding which connections to make. Work through the levels by finding a route that covers the figure instead of leaving an isolated section unfinished.

pages.title: Ball Bump 3D
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Guide a ball through six physics-based courses in Ball Bump 3D. Use the white obstacles to push a way through and steer clear of colored pieces. Watch where the blocks and balls roll after you hit them so you can keep a clear route to the finish.

pages.title: Match Solitaire
pages.creator: FreeGames.org
pages.description: Clear the layout in Match Solitaire by pairing exposed cards of the same rank. The suits can differ, so a four of clubs and a four of spades can go together. Look for pairs that uncover more cards and keep matching until the board is clear.

pages.title: Conquer the Galaxy
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Build up your population and send forces to nearby planets in Conquer the Galaxy. Take territory from the alien factions before they seize yours. Decide which planets are worth attacking as your population grows, and use your gains to put pressure on the next enemy world.

pages.title: Stickman Briefcase
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Dodge falling missiles in Stickman Briefcase and use the magic briefcase to help you survive. Watch the sky while moving between gaps and collect gold coins when you can reach them safely. Try different characters to see how their abilities change your chances of lasting longer.

pages.title: BFFs World Cup Face Paint
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Get Elsa and Ariel ready to cheer at the World Cup in BFFs World Cup Face Paint. Choose football-themed face paint and style each fan for the final. Use the paint and outfit together to show which team each character has come to support.

pages.title: Space Adventure Pinball
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: Keep the ball in play in Space Adventure Pinball. Use the flippers to send it back up the space-themed table and score points as it strikes targets. Watch its return path and time your flips to keep it from slipping between them.

pages.title: Piano Kids
pages.creator: ReCorp Games
pages.description: Play notes and trigger animations in Piano Kids. Switch among piano, guitar, flute, and xylophone sounds, or press the song button to hear a melody. Try day and night modes to change the look of the scene while you explore the keys.

pages.title: Thrill Rush 5
pages.creator: Azerion Casual Games
pages.description: Ride a roller coaster with collapsing tracks in Thrill Rush 5. Watch for gaps and time your jumps while grabbing cash along the route. Decide which money you can safely reach and keep the rider going when the rails break apart ahead.

pages.title: Cycling to School
pages.creator: Casual_Azerion_Old
pages.description: Choose a look for the ride in Cycling to School. Pick an outfit and accessories, then select the bicycle that goes with them. Try a few combinations to see how a change of bike or clothing changes the style of the trip to school.

pages.title: Love Tester 3
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Enter two names in Love Tester 3 and press the button to get a playful compatibility percentage. Try another pair to see how the result changes. The game turns each pair of names into a quick score you can compare with earlier results.

pages.title: Princess On Vacation
pages.creator: Games Banner Network
pages.description: Help Elsa pack and head to the airport in Princess On Vacation. After checking in, choose where to go and put together an outfit for the destination. Dress for the beach, a restaurant, or a nightclub as the trip moves from one stop to the next.

pages.title: Zombie Killer
pages.creator: QkyGames
pages.description: Move up and down to line up shots against approaching zombies in Zombie Killer. Fire at the undead before they reach your base, and shoot coins to collect money for weapon upgrades. Improve your firing speed or other weapon abilities as you work through the levels.
